Container.Name: nordvpn
Container.Overview: The official NordVPN Linux client on distroless: no shell, rebuilt when upstream changes. Use it as a VPN network for other containers (Network Type: Container) with kill switch and allowlist set from env, or as a Meshnet node. Needs NET_ADMIN, NET_RAW and /dev/net/tun (set in Extra Parameters).

Config.Name: Access token
Config.Description: NordVPN account → Manual setup → Access token.

Config.Name: Connect
Config.Description: Country/city/server/group, anything `nordvpn connect` accepts. Empty = recommended server.

Config.Name: Allowlist
Config.Description: ; separated, each passed to `nordvpn allowlist add`. Replaces the allowlist each start.

Config.Name: State
Config.Description: Login and Meshnet identity across restarts.
